summary_zh: Yazi 是一个用 Rust 编写、基于异步 I/O 的终端文件管理器，提供异步任务调度、内置图片预览与代码高亮、Lua 插件系统、虚拟文件系统、多标签与批量重命名等功能，目标是高效、易用且可定制的文件管理体验。
audience_zh: 适合习惯终端操作、需要在命令行中管理文件并希望获得快速预览与可扩展能力的用户，尤其是重视异步性能、插件定制和类 Vim 交互体验的开发者；项目处于公开测试阶段，可作为日常使用但可能有破坏性变更。

evidence.quote: 💥 Blazing fast terminal file manager written in Rust, based on async I/O.
Yazi (means "duck") is a terminal file manager written in Rust, based on non-blocking async I/O. It aims to provide an efficient, user-friendly, and customizable file management experience.
- 🔌 **Concurrent Plugin System**: UI plugins (rewriting most of the UI), functional plugins, custom previewer/preloader/spotter/fetcher; Just some pieces of Lua.
Public beta, can be used as a daily driver.
